meta.title: ES/MES ORB Strategy - Prop Firm Compliance Framework

daily_max_loss.description: Maximum loss allowed per trading day
daily_max_loss.rule: Stop trading if daily loss exceeds this amount
daily_max_loss.rationale: Prevents catastrophic days; aligns with prop firm standards

weekly_max_loss.rule: If weekly loss exceeds this, stop trading until next week
weekly_max_loss.rationale: Allows for variance while maintaining discipline

monthly_max_drawdown.description: Maximum peak-to-trough drawdown in any month
monthly_max_drawdown.rule: If DD exceeds this, reduce position size to 50% until recovery
monthly_max_drawdown.rationale: Prop firms (Lucid: 10%, Apex: 15%) require DD limits

max_concurrent_trades.rule: Cannot open new trade if already holding one
max_concurrent_trades.rationale: Strategy is designed for 1 trade/day; prevents correlation risk

trading_hours.rule: ORB window: 08:00-08:15 ET. Entries until 11:00 ET. Forced flat at 11:00 ET.
trading_hours.rationale: Avoids illiquid periods; ensures clean exits

max_trades_per_week.rule: Reduces to 3/week due to low frequency; prevents over-trading
max_trades_per_week.rationale: System generates ~1 trade per 3 days; cap at 3 to avoid signal degradation

base_unit.description: Scaleable: 1 MES = 1/10 ES contract, ideal for sizing

risk_per_trade.rule: Risk $100 per trade (4 stop-loss points * $25/point on MES)
risk_per_trade.calculation: Stop loss = 4 points (ORB range typically 10-40 pts)
risk_per_trade.recommendation: Scale to 5 MES = $100 risk per trade once consistency proven

tier_2.gate: If tier_1 metrics maintained, profit consistent

pre_market_08_00: ✅ Log into broker (TD Ameritrade / Interactive Brokers / Thinkorswim)
✅ Set up orders: buy breakout at ORB_HIGH+1tick, sell breakout at ORB_LOW-1tick
✅ Set up alerts: notify when breakout triggered
during_orb_08_00_to_08_15: ✅ Record ORB values in trading journal
post_orb_08_15_to_11_00: ✅ Wait for breakout of ORB high or low (NO RETEST required in V1.0)
✅ Confirm: Close > ORB_HIGH (long) or Close < ORB_LOW (short)
✅ Confirm: Price > VWAP (long only) - if price < VWAP, skip trade
✅ Enter on close if all conditions met (market or limit order)
✅ Set stop loss: 4 points away from entry (50 ticks on ES, 250 ticks on MES)
✅ Set target: 1R at 50pts, 2R at 100pts, 3R at 150pts (scale out)
✅ Log: Entry time, entry price, reason, stop level, target levels
exit_management: ✅ Remaining 25%: let ride to SL or 11:00 ET flat
✅ If SL hit: record loss, reason, and any notes for analysis
end_of_day_11_00: ✅ Log daily P&L: wins/losses, largest win, largest loss
✅ Check daily loss limit: if -$500, STOP trading (resume next day)
✅ Check weekly loss limit: if -$1,500, PAUSE trading rest of week
✅ Update trading journal: psychology notes, execution quality, slippage
end_of_week_friday: ✅ Review all stop-loss trades: patterns? improvements?
✅ Check if any rules were violated

weekly_audit: ☑️ All trades documented (entry time, price, reason, exit time, price, reason)
☑️ Daily loss limit not exceeded any day
☑️ Stop losses properly set and monitored
monthly_audit: ☑️ All trades follow documented rules (no discretion)
☑️ Slippage acceptable (< 1 tick avg on entry)

100_trade_milestone.fail: Return to analysis; optimize SL or entry logic

500_trade_milestone.fail: Continue trading current size; investigate variance

primary.name: MES (Micro E-mini S&P 500)
primary.why: Ideal for prop firm: low cost per contract, high liquidity, easy scaling

secondary.name: ES (E-mini S&P 500)
secondary.note: Risk: $500-1000 per trade at this size; requires strong psychology

future.name: MNQ (Micro E-mini Nasdaq), RTY (Micro E-mini Russell)
future.why: Apply same rules to different indices; diversify

lucid.name: Lucid Markets
lucid.your_status: ✅ Meets requirements (current: 29.6% DD on small sample; need to improve)

if_dd_exceeds_10_pct.duration: Until recovered to max DD (50% of previous max)

if_dd_exceeds_15_pct.action: Stop trading; switch to analysis only
if_dd_exceeds_15_pct.investigate: What went wrong? Market regime change? Rules violated? SL too tight?

if_daily_loss_exceeds_limit.journal_entry: Document: What happened? Execution error? Bad luck? Rule violation?

gate_3_quarterly_review.result_pass: Scale to 5+ MES; apply for prop firm

gate_4_prop_firm_auditable.result_fail: Continue proprietary trading or return to analysis

for_prop_firm: ✅ Full audit trail (every trade logged with reason)
✅ Backtest results (200+ trades on real data)
